event.text: Ecuadorian presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio was assassinated in Quito, eleven days before the general election.
event.page_extract: Fernando Alcibiades Villavicencio Valencia was an Ecuadorian journalist, trade unionist, and politician who ran for president of Ecuador in the 2023 Ecuadorian general election. He served as a member of the National Assembly from 2021 until the dissolution of the legislative body on 17 May 2023, which caused the 2023 Ecuadorian political crisis and a snap election.

title: The Unfinished Speech
artist_statement: I wanted to capture the silence that follows a voice cut short. There is a weight in the empty space where a promise once stood, a stillness that feels louder than any roar. The light still falls on the podium, but no one steps forward to claim it.
image_prompt: A dimly lit campaign rally stage after the crowd has fled. A single microphone stands on a wooden podium, its metal mesh catching a warm amber spotlight from above. To the left, a folding chair lies on its side, its legs pointing toward the shadows. A blue campaign banner hangs crookedly in the background, partially torn. On the floor near the podium, a scattered stack of papers and a tipped-over cup of water glisten under the light. The palette is muted: deep indigos, burnt umber, and ochre, with the spotlight creating a stark contrast. Thick impasto on the fallen chair and papers; thin, almost transparent washes on the dark walls. The atmosphere is heavy and still, as if the air itself is holding its breath.
